title: Ask the User to Confirm
description: Raise a confirmation: record a question for the user and surface it in the dashboard. Use this when you judge that the user should decide for themselves - an irreversible step, an ambiguous goal, or a genuinely new kind of action. This is your own initiative, not a permission check: it blocks nothing, nothing waits for the answer, and no other capability depends on it. Raise the question, then carry on with whatever you can already do. Never call this because a manifest, a risk level or a rule says approval is required, and never call it for work the user has already delegated to you.

summary.description: One line the user reads first: what you are asking, in their language.

reason.description: Why you are asking instead of deciding - what you are unsure about.

capability_id.description: The capability you intend to use, if the question concerns one.

tool_name.description: The tool you intend to use, if any.

risk.description: Your own assessment of the intended action. Shown to the user; never used to decide anything.

target.description: What the intended action would affect.

preview.description: What the user would see happen.

side_effects.description: Anything else the action would change.

task_id.description: The task this question belongs to, if any.

step_id.description: The step this question belongs to, if any.

expires_at.description: Optional deadline in epoch milliseconds. Defaults to 30 minutes from now.
